notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: He scored 43 points in 39 minutes Monday and 42 in 35 minutes Wednesday, both against Cleveland, for 66.25 and 61.5 DraftKings points. Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks and Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are still out, so the offense keeps running through him at Memphis.
notes.Cooper Flagg: He has played 40 minutes in each of his last two games, with 19 points, 10 rebounds and five assists Wednesday. Dereck Lively II is still out, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, which thins the frontcourt he faces.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He rested Wednesday, his first missed game of the season, and he is not on Boston's injury report for Charlotte. He played 32 to 42 minutes in his last four games before the rest day, and Charlotte is without Kon Knueppel and Grant Williams.
notes.Scottie Barnes: He is questionable tonight at Milwaukee, so check his status before lock. He played 32 minutes Wednesday with 17 points after 36 to 39 minutes in his three games before that, and Kawhi Leonard is out again.
notes.Jalen Johnson: He is questionable tonight against Washington with a left ankle sprain after missing Atlanta's last two games, and the Hawks play again Saturday. Kingston Flemings started Wednesday with Johnson out.
notes.Deandre Ayton: He played only 11 minutes off the bench Wednesday once Alex Sarr returned, after starting Monday for 24 minutes with Sarr out. Anthony Davis is questionable with an ankle sprain, and if Davis sits, more frontcourt minutes open for him.
notes.Kenrich Williams: He has started Oklahoma City's last two games and played 31 and 29 minutes, with 13 points and three threes Wednesday. Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Cason Wallace are all out tonight.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: He has come off the bench in each of his last four games at 22 to 33 minutes, with 23 on Wednesday. Anthony Davis is questionable with an ankle sprain, and Jamir Watkins and Justin Champagnie are out.
He has played between 12 and 18 minutes in every game, including 17 and 18 in his last two, and he has apparently been on a minutes limit. Dereck Lively II is still out, so the backup center minutes stay with him.
He played 24 and 21 minutes in his last two games while Max Christie was hurt, scoring 20 Monday. Christie is listed as probable tonight, so those minutes could shrink.
notes.Jakob Poeltl: He came off the bench Wednesday behind Collin Murray-Boyles and played 19 minutes after missing two games with a shoulder issue. Expect a bench role rather than a start, though Kawhi Leonard is out and Scottie Barnes is questionable.
notes.Meleek Thomas: He played 18 minutes off the bench Wednesday after starting Monday for 26 minutes. Jaylon Tyson is out, and Jarrett Allen, Peyton Watson and Tyrese Proctor are all questionable, so his minutes depend on who sits.
notes.Jerami Grant: He has played 23 or 24 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games. Scotty Pippen Jr. and Isaiah Stewart are out tonight, which keeps his role steady.
notes.Anthony Davis: He is questionable tonight at Atlanta with a right ankle sprain that he played through Wednesday, when he had 26 points in 30 minutes for 50.5 DraftKings points. Washington plays again Saturday.
notes.Payton Pritchard: He is questionable at Charlotte with a right eye abrasion after missing the fourth quarter Wednesday and playing 18 minutes.
notes.Jarrett Allen: He is questionable tonight with a right knee contusion after playing only seven scoreless minutes Wednesday. He played 24 to 30 minutes as a starter in his four games before that.
notes.Tyrese Proctor: He started Wednesday and played 22 minutes but is questionable tonight with a left ankle sprain.
notes.Trey Murphy III: He is probable tonight against Minnesota after missing Wednesday. He played 29 to 40 minutes in each of his last four games before that.
notes.Dennis Schroder: He is questionable tonight against Boston. He has come off the bench in his last two games at 23 and 20 minutes after starting before that.
notes.Moussa Diabate: He is questionable tonight against Boston. He has started every game we tracked and played 29 minutes Wednesday.
notes.Kingston Flemings: He started Wednesday with Jalen Johnson out and played 23 minutes. If Johnson sits again tonight, the start likely stays with him.
notes.Alex Sarr: He returned Wednesday and played 23 minutes with 11 points and nine rebounds, and he is not on Washington's injury report tonight. Anthony Davis is questionable, which could add to his minutes.
